summary: Computer Science graduate and award-winning Full-Stack Engineer specializing in scalable web architectures and AI automation. Fluent in the modern stack (React, Next.js, Laravel, Python, TypeScript) and workflow orchestration (n8n, Docker), I combine deep technical rigor with a product-driven mindset to transform complex operational bottlenecks into intelligent, high-impact digital solutions.
